goal: Inventory a thin EntryFieldWriteAdapter boundary and lossless FieldType transport without product, TUI, value-write, or frozen-core changes
direct_dependencies: existing thin CategoryWriteAdapter and EntryWriteAdapter pattern
tests_explicitly_not_run: TUI regression because runtime/product code is untouched
browser regression because web code is untouched
repository/domain/storage regression because frozen core is untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: FieldType transport is straightforward, but the adapter return model must not misuse FieldRow because FieldRow already includes presentation/value semantics
a later adapter implementation must preserve DomainError propagation and must not silently coerce unknown strings into FieldType
category-field creation, field values, choice options and TUI integration remain separate scopes
non_changes: no field-value, choice-option or value-write changes
no trash/restore, undo, autosave or crash-recovery
no theme, dependency or CI changes
expected_side_effects: after freeze, a follow-up may implement only a thin EntryFieldWriteAdapter protocol/delegation seam if it can do so without changing frozen contracts
